title: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules, versions 2.0.2 through 10.0.3, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special…
description: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules versions 2.0.2 through 10.0.3 have a vulnerability in the OData filter processing component that allows improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic. This flaw could be exploited by a low privileged attacker with remote access to gain unauthorized data access, bypass authorization, and cause denial of service.
